title.en: A living cell, filmed in chemical 3D
title.zh: 活细胞内部的三维化学电影

summary.en: Tokyo researchers demonstrated 19.2 chemical volumes per second inside living cells. The advance tracks lipid droplets; deeper tissue imaging remains a separate challenge.
summary.zh: 东京研究团队每秒重建19.2幅活细胞三维化学图像，追踪脂滴运动；深层组织成像仍是另一道难题。

title.en: An internal compass for drifting AI teams
title.zh: 为偏离任务的AI团队加一道内部罗盘

summary.en: ATLAS steers accessible internal model states toward the task, role and latest shared information. Its authors report benchmark gains with costs and access limits.
summary.zh: ATLAS将可访问的模型内部状态拉回任务、角色与最新共享信息；作者报告测试改进，同时存在成本与访问条件。
